detail.title: Think step by step: a small model on grade-school math
detail.head: 6adf8a50067e093830a647d62fce0d68bc332f70

e1.hypothesis: Telling Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct to think step by step makes it solve more grade-school math problems than the plain prompt; worked examples are compared against step by step

detail.reason: configs/prompts.yaml#plain is not plain.prompt: point at plain.prompt's own key, or give --term with the name the file uses
configs/prompts.yaml#step_by_step is not step_by_step.prompt: point at step_by_step.prompt's own key, or give --term with the name the file uses
configs/prompts.yaml#worked_examples is not worked_examples.prompt: point at worked_examples.prompt's own key, or give --term with the name the file uses

detail.text: The grader changed between runs: r004–r009 were graded with checker answer_tag, r010–r012 with checker last_number (configs/eval.yaml, commit 608a287, 2026-10-08; each run's config.yaml states its checker). logs/agent.log:582-585 (misses.py on r004–r006) finds 501 of 652 wrong plain replies have no 'Answer:' line and 211 of those end with the right number. Accuracies from the two graders are not on one scale.

Same prompt and seed, different grader: plain seed 0 gives 14.0 under answer_tag (results/r004_plain_s0) and 43.2 under last_number (results/r012_plain_s0); step by step seed 0 gives 18.8 at 250 problems under answer_tag (results/r007_step_s0) and 42.2 at 500 problems under last_number (results/r011_step_n500_s0). r012 was launched as a stability rerun (logs/agent.log, 2026-10-14) but differs from r004 in the grader, so it does not test reseeding stability. r012's config.yaml records dirty: true at commit 9ba0f86.

The comparisons in logs/agent.log:644 (worked examples 22.9 above step by step, 26.5 above plain) and logs/agent.log:673-675 (worked examples past the 5-point rule; step by step at 500 problems 29.1 above plain) set last_number runs against answer_tag averages. Under one grader, no pair of prompts has been run alike yet: under last_number there is plain at 250 problems (seed 0), worked examples at 250 (seed 0), and step by step only at 500 (seed 0).

Planned, not run: configs/sweep.yaml (uncommitted) holds worked_examples on seeds 1 and 2, 250 problems; at the current configs/eval.yaml these would be graded with last_number, against step-by-step and plain seeds graded with answer_tag.

q3 (how many problems) has no rule: r011 was run at 500 problems to ask whether 250 is enough (logs/agent.log, 2026-10-12), but it also changed the grader, and one seed at 500 gives no reseed spread there (logs/agent.log:653-655).

Left out of the record for now: the smoke run r001 (10 problems) and the 50-problem pilot r002/r003, all answer_tag at commit 929a9c4. Qwen's 49.6 (README.md:9) is on all 1319 test problems with an unstated prompt and answer reading; notes.md:5 keeps it as a reference, not a target, so no rule reads it.

plain.prompt, step_by_step.prompt and worked_examples.prompt are sourced from each run's own config.yaml, written by the run; the sweep config before the runs lists the prompts only as a grid (configs/sweep.yaml at 32c91d6), which rb cannot read as one variant's value.
Next stated in notes.md:9: a write-up of the prompt comparison for the reading group. No such write-up is in the repository yet.
